5973.title: Thread deletion confirmation counts a different relationship than its cascade
5973.rootCauseOneLine: Delete confirmation counts parentThreadId children, but deletion traverses lifecycleOwnerThreadId dependents; sidebar-only children survive.
5973.proposedFix: Align the delete warning and counted relationship with an explicit lifecycle policy. No automated PR: existing tests require sidebar-only children to survive, so broadening destructive traversal needs a product decision.
5973.caveats: No browser/macOS session was run. The core route behavior reproduced twice; a persistent dangling parent reference did not reproduce after physical cleanup. Existing lifecycle and parenting suites: 28 tests passed.
